ASMA90.rationale: IBM documents ASMA90 as the z/OS batch assembler entry point.

DFHCSDUP.rationale: IBM identifies DFHCSDUP as the offline CSD resource-definition utility.

DFHECP1$.rationale: IBM APAR PH41716 explicitly identifies DFHECP1$ as the CICS stand-alone COBOL translator; the dollar suffix is part of the program name.

DFSRRC00.rationale: IBM identifies DFSRRC00 as the IMS region controller, not an application program.

DSNHPC.rationale: IBM identifies DSNHPC as the Db2 precompiler load module.

FTP.rationale: IBM supplies batch FTP JCL invoking PGM=FTP; installed configuration and entitlement remain operator evidence.

HEWL.rationale: IBM lists HEWL as a link-edit EXEC program name.

IDCAMS.rationale: IBM identifies IDCAMS as access method services for catalogs and VSAM datasets.

IEBGENER.rationale: IBM identifies IEBGENER as the operating-system sequential dataset copy utility.

IEFBR14.rationale: IBM identifies IEFBR14 as the system utility returning completion code zero for allocation/deallocation jobs.

IEWL.rationale: IBM lists IEWL as a link-edit EXEC program name.

IGYCRCTL.rationale: IBM identifies IGYCRCTL as the Enterprise COBOL compiler invoked by EXEC.

IKJEFT01.rationale: IBM identifies IKJEFT01 as a TSO/E background terminal monitor program.

IKJEFT1B.rationale: IBM identifies IKJEFT1B as a TSO/E background terminal monitor program; this source invokes the TXT2PDF command through it.

SDSF.rationale: IBM documents PGM=SDSF as the batch entry point supporting commands and action characters.

SORT.rationale: IBM documents EXEC PGM=SORT for DFSORT; actual installed sort product remains an operator confirmation.
